discussion_comments.comment_body: The IPC router selects the backend from outer `request.profile` (`apps/desktop/electron/main.ts:7916-7928`) and forwards `request.body` unchanged; `/api/audio/speak` binds `TTSSpeakRequest`, which contains only `text` (`hermes_cli/web_server.py:3746-3748`). This nested field does not scope routing, so keep the body as `{ text }`.

Profile routing is incomplete for these plugin endpoints. In global-remote mode Electron appends `profile` to this request path (`apps/desktop/electron/connection-config.ts:199-232`), but `plugins/kanban/dashboard/plugin_api.py:get_board` only accepts `board` and does not enter a profile scope. The selected desktop profile can therefore read the backend-default board.

Please add `...profileScoped()` to this request. `getHermesConfig()` already scopes the timeout source to the active profile, while Electron routes the actual backend request only when `request.profile` is present; without it, a non-primary profile still synthesizes against the primary backend.

This carries the source in `request.profile`, so Electron routes the PATCH to that owner and, for a per-profile remote, strips the field before forwarding. `move_to_profile` is not used for destination routing, so moves involving a remote destination cannot reach that destination backend. Please either scope the UI to co-located profiles or add explicit transfer routing and coverage.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Passing `profile` only in the query does not make Electron route this request to that profile's local or remote backend. Existing session mutations pass `profile` in the `window.hermesDesktop.api` request envelope; add that routing field to every folder operation and cover a remote-profile call.

This new parameter is ignored. Canvas discovery passes each `profile.name`, but remote reads still use `desktopFsProfile()` through `remoteFsApi`, so every request goes to the active backend. Thread an explicit profile override through the facade and add a remote multi-profile test.
Addressed in f658fa406d and covered by 03ac2097f3. The filesystem facade now forwards the explicit Canvas profile to remote reads, and the regression test verifies it overrides the active profile.

The remote delete bypasses `remoteFsApi` and omits `profile`, so it does not target `selectedCanvas.profile`. Use the same explicit profile routing as remote reads before permitting destructive actions.
Addressed in f658fa406d and covered by 03ac2097f3. Remote deletion now uses the same profile-aware facade, and the regression test verifies the DELETE request carries the selected profile.
